purpose: Specify the testable data, entitlement, provenance and acceptance package required before a cost-aware paper replay. This is not a data licence, a performance result, an allocation or an investment action.

data_dictionary_template.boundary: The template supplies normalized field names and controls only. A freeze record must bind DPSFS-DD-v8, its schema version, approved source mapping and SHA-256 before replay; a different dictionary is not an implicit substitute.

definitions.as_of: The economic or trading-session time to which a source record refers.
definitions.available_at: The earliest documented timestamp at which the source made the specific record available to the research process; vendor publication time and local receipt time are stored separately.
definitions.retrospective: A historic record fetched after its as_of date without a vendor-provided historical available_at/vintage record. It cannot be represented as point-in-time evidence.
definitions.no_fill: A predeclared state in which a required transaction cannot occur under documented market, route or contract conditions. It is not a zero-cost close fill.
definitions.source_revision: A supplier-defined revision/version identifier or, if none exists, an append-only local revision sequence tied to the raw-response hash.
definitions.replay_run_freeze_record: The single immutable, signed, hash-addressed run-binding entity keyed by replay_run_id. Its replay_run_freeze_record_sha256 is the only permissible run-binding hash for a formal replay.
definitions.bound_row: A replay-run-scoped row that carries replay_run_id and replay_run_freeze_record_sha256 and whose values equal the canonical frozen run-binding entity byte-for-byte.
definitions.execution_state: The lifecycle state of the order/fill attempt. It is distinct from settlement_state; SUBMITTED and FAILED are execution states, not evidence of settlement.
definitions.settlement_state: The lifecycle state of cash, delivery or clearing settlement after a fill. Settlement FAILED is distinct from execution FAILED because it is stored in the separate settlement-state domain.
definitions.fill_leg: One immutable incremental execution for an order, keyed by order and sequence, carrying delta, cumulative and residual quantity plus its own price, cost components and settlement allocation.

freeze_control.draft_boundary: No raw data package, rulebook version, universe, allocation, replay result or action is approved by this draft.

change_control.before_freeze: Changes require a version increment, a documented rationale and an independent R0 review.
change_control.after_freeze: Any material field, timing, universe, cost, acceptance-threshold or rule change creates a new contract/rulebook version and invalidates comparability with the frozen replay until separately reviewed.
prohibited: Editing a frozen raw file in place.
Replacing a failed observation with a forward-filled price, inferred fill or undisclosed vendor revision.
Changing an acceptance threshold after viewing the result it evaluates.

cross_bound_artifacts: replay-run freeze record and bound-row admission policy
U0 snapshot and U0-to-T2 derivation audit
primary-holdout start-state policy and integrity audit
order-transition-chain invariant and cash/margin/settlement event schema
endpoint calculation/population roster and count-audit schema
unitization, position/lot/mark, cashflow/P&L and reconciliation controls
execution-model/tradability, execution-versus-settlement state, end-of-run carry/cancel, fill-leg/partial-fill allocation, fee-tax/currency and endpoint-result controls
dated broker/tax component-term foreign keys and exact event-type-to-application-role mapping
prospective state/configuration coverage-audit schema and zero-blocking-row assertion
canonical_replay_freeze_crosswalk.equality_rule: The canonical record stores each referenced ID, version and SHA-256 exactly once. The replay runtime, protocol report, daily ledger and endpoint table must echo those values byte-for-byte. A missing, duplicated-with-different-value or unmatched binding is INVALID; no result or holdout label may be released.
canonical_replay_freeze_crosswalk.timing_rule: The canonical record must state the source_revision_cutoff, replay_code_commit, runtime_environment_lock_or_hash, exact_run_command, lockbox_holdout_start/end, maximum_input_lookback_or_warmup and first_permitted_outcome_view_at. It also binds the primary-holdout start-state, conditional submission-path/timestamp, cash/collateral role-applicability, scope-resolution, transition-chain, event-schema, endpoint calculation/population, unitization/lot/reconciliation, execution-model/tradability, execution-settlement separation, end-of-run carry/cancel, fill-leg allocation, broker-tax component FK, event-role mapping, fee-tax/currency, prospective-coverage and endpoint-result policies before any outcome view.

frozen_run_binding_and_bound_row_control.immutability_rule: Exactly one signed canonical record is active for one replay_run_id. replay_run_freeze_record_sha256 is computed from the canonical freeze serialization excluding that hash field itself (or from the separately named canonical freeze artifact), never from a self-referential row hash. After approval, every material field, referenced SHA-256 and that canonical serialization is immutable. A correction requires a new replay_run_id and new signed record; no in-place mutation, alias or post-result rebinding is permitted.

bound_row_policy.equality_rule: Every bound-row replay_run_id resolves to exactly one canonical record, and the row's replay_run_freeze_record_sha256 binding field must equal that parent record's replay_run_freeze_record_sha256 byte-for-byte. Independent row/content hashes remain their own values and must not be forced to equal the parent binding hash. A row may not mix input, dictionary, policy, source-cutoff or code bindings from another run.
bound_row_policy.admission_rule: A run-scoped row without both foreign keys, with an unmatched hash, a duplicate primary identity under different binding hashes, or a binding created after first outcome view is rejected from formal replay and counted as INVALID rather than omitted.
bound_row_policy.cross_table_rule: All foreign keys between run-scoped tables must preserve the same replay_run_id and replay_run_freeze_record_sha256. Cross-run joins, inferred binding from file location and narrative-only binding are prohibited.

frozen_run_binding_and_bound_row_control.failure_rule: A missing, mutable, noncanonical or unequal run binding, or a row admitted without the required bound-row foreign keys, is INVALID and blocks all endpoint, holdout and usable-strategy labels.

fx_calendar_and_unitization_method_contr.fx_conversion_rule: Every non-ledger-currency amount in a position mark, cashflow/P&L row, fee/tax component or cash/margin/settlement event must reference one frozen_fx_quote_conversion row by fx_quote_id/fx_quote_sha256 and use its frozen rate, observation time, policy, basis and rounding. For execution_fee_tax_component, amount must equal term_calculated_amount times the selected frozen rate under fx_rounding_mode/fx_rounding_decimal_places, or be the declared identity-currency case with the same explicit quote/basis evidence. The from/to currencies, converted ledger_currency_amount and daily fx_quote_set_sha256 must reconcile exactly; a null, reused incompatible, inferred or post-cutoff rate is INVALID.
fx_calendar_and_unitization_method_contr.calendar_coverage_rule: The frozen master_calendar_daily_coverage_rule_id/SHA governs one bound daily valuation-coverage row for every required session in each candidate endpoint and evaluation warmup interval. Roster/result endpoint_window_coverage_row_count, endpoint_window_covered_count, endpoint_window_coverage_set_sha256 and endpoint_window_coverage_status must resolve exactly to those rows; population evaluation_warmup coverage fields must reconcile to the same bound calendar. Missing, duplicate, out-of-range or non-covered sessions make the candidate INCOMPLETE or INVALID, never silently shortened.
fx_calendar_and_unitization_method_contr.unitization_nav_bridge_rule: Every portfolio_unitization_ledger row references the frozen method ID/version/SHA. The unique first OPENING row has prior_unitization_ledger_id null and opening_units zero. Every non-OPENING row references exactly one immediately prior row ordered by valuation_at then unitization_ledger_id, with prior valuation_at strictly earlier and opening_units exactly equal to that prior closing_units; reset, gap, reversal or alternate predecessor paths are INVALID. The declared external_flow_timing, external_flow_pricing_unit_nav, unit issuance/redemption, prior/current NAV and unit NAV must be reproducible from frozen_unitization_method_definition and unitization_calculation_input_set_sha256. daily_portfolio_ledger.nav_bridge_input_set_sha256 binds the unit, positions/lots/marks, cashflow/P&L and event-balance inputs; external flows cannot be converted into performance.
fx_calendar_and_unitization_method_contr.event_balance_and_time_order_rule: Each execution_cash_margin_settlement_ledger_event carries balance_effect_bucket/sign, ledger_currency_amount, exact FX quote/rounding, formula/input-set hash and, when applicable, prior/current settlement price, calculation quantity, settlement-obligation status and cashflow_pnl_id. Its effective_at and linked source/transition/fill times must be causally ordered; daily event_balance_routing_set_sha256 and reconciliation residuals must prove that every signed event posts once to the stated balance bucket. Gross notional, variation/final settlement and unpaid obligations may not be netted away.
fx_calendar_and_unitization_method_contr.failure_rule: A missing frozen parent field, FX quote, calendar-coverage row, unitization-method row, NAV bridge, event-balance routing, formula input set or causal timestamp ordering is INVALID and blocks endpoint, holdout and usable-strategy labels.

endpoint_calculation_and_population_audi.anchor_start_end_rule: For every rostered candidate, calendar_anchor_at is the canonical five-calendar-year anchor a, selected_start_valuation_at is the deterministic master-calendar valuation selection s at or before a, endpoint_end_valuation_at is the canonical endpoint e, window_start must equal s and window_end must equal e, and elapsed_calendar_days is the positive day difference from s to e. required_window_calendar_days must equal the frozen five-calendar-year rule. The start/end daily-ledger foreign keys must resolve to the stated valuation dates and total/unit NAVs. annualized_net_twrr is computed from end_unit_nav divided by start_unit_nav (or an equivalently chain-linked unit-NAV series), never from a total-NAV ratio when external cash flows exist; endpoint_calculation_sha256 covers the unit-NAV inputs, flow treatment and formula. A prose table, inferred date or recomputed alternate anchor is not an endpoint calculation record.

roster_membership_and_partition_equality.roster_identity_rule: Every replay_candidate_endpoint_roster row has candidate_endpoint_roster_id and candidate_endpoint_roster_sha256 equal byte-for-byte to replay_run_freeze_record. Candidate generation, membership, calendar_anchor_at, selected_start_valuation_at, endpoint_end_valuation_at, elapsed_calendar_days and expected_partition are frozen row values; no regenerated, filtered or alternate roster is admissible.
roster_membership_and_partition_equality.partition_count_rule: The count of roster rows by expected_partition must equal expected_development_count, expected_primary_holdout_candidate_endpoint_count and expected_crossing_count respectively; replay_endpoint_result.endpoint_partition must equal the joined roster.expected_partition for every candidate_endpoint_id. Any missing, duplicate, mismatched, reclassified or unrepresented candidate is INVALID.

endpoint_status_validation.validation_rule: After INVALID and INCOMPLETE precedence checks, endpoint_status is PASS if annualized_net_twrr >= 0.05 and FAIL if annualized_net_twrr < 0.05. The signed endpoint_calculation_sha256 binds the metric inputs, external-cashflow treatment and formula; a status not mechanically equal to this rule is INVALID.

endpoint_calculation_and_population_audi.count_reconciliation_rule: The signed population audit must show expected_candidate_endpoint_count equals actual_candidate_endpoint_count equals the unique roster count; expected and actual DEVELOPMENT, PRIMARY_HOLDOUT and CROSSING counts reconcile; status_count_total equals pass_count plus fail_count plus incomplete_count plus invalid_count and equals actual_candidate_endpoint_count; and count_residual is zero with population_reconciliation_status PASS. Missing candidate rows, duplicate roster keys, missing anchor/start/end/elapsed evidence, or any zero/shortfall/mismatch remains visible and is INCOMPLETE or INVALID under the protocol; it cannot be repaired by shrinking the population.
endpoint_calculation_and_population_audi.failure_rule: An endpoint result without a canonical roster row, start/end ledger foreign keys, calculation audit or matching population audit is INVALID and cannot contribute to a Boolean hurdle.

unitization_positions_lots_marks_cashflo.economic_position_and_reservation_rule: economic_closing_quantity and marked NAV reflect actual filled economic positions only. An unfilled sell reservation reduces available_to_sell capacity but must not reduce economic_closing_quantity, marked value or NAV. ETF position_side may be LONG or FLAT only: ETF SHORT inventory, OPEN_SHORT/CLOSE_SHORT order paths and borrow assumptions are out of scope. execution_feasibility_reservation aggregates by cash, margin and lot pool; aggregate active reservations cannot exceed the same pool's eligible before-balance or reserve the same lot/cash/margin twice.

reconciliation_expected_matrix_control.set_reconciliation_rule: expected_reconciliation_row_count equals the mandatory row count plus applicable conditional rows; actual_reconciliation_residual_row_count equals expected_reconciliation_row_count; expected_reconciliation_matrix_set_sha256 is the generated expected-row hash; and reconciliation_residual_set_sha256 is the actual set hash with exact expected-matrix membership. Any mismatch is INVALID.

unitization_positions_lots_marks_cashflo.start_state_rule: Each PRIMARY_HOLDOUT start-state manifest must have normalized primary_holdout_start_state_component rows foreign-keying every declared unit, position/lot/mark, cashflow/P&L and reconciliation component to a bound ledger row at state_reset_at or window_start. A neutral reset is valid only when its zero/initial values, unit count and no-position/no-obligation status are explicit and reconciled; an aggregate NAV, hashes without component membership rows or an unexplained reset is insufficient.
unitization_positions_lots_marks_cashflo.transaction_time_feasibility_rule: At every DECISION, SUBMISSION and FILL context_at, execution_feasibility_reservation records the applicable cash, collateral, margin or lot pool. A FILL row carries its fill_id; a listed-security sale links position_id, lot_id and available_to_sell_from to the dated T+1 rule, with eligible_to_sell_quantity, active_sell_reservation_quantity and available_to_sell_quantity resolved in portfolio_position_lot_mark_ledger. Before/preexisting/new/after reservation balances must reconcile and may not double-reserve the same cash, margin or T+1 lot. economic_closing_quantity and NAV remain economic quantities and are not reduced by an unfilled sell reservation. Released/cancelled/carry reservation entries are timestamped. Fractional economic unitization does not waive integer lot, T+1, cash or margin feasibility evidence.
unitization_positions_lots_marks_cashflo.failure_rule: A missing unitization phase, lot/mark, cashflow/P&L component, reconciliation residual, start-state foreign key, reservation or T+1 eligibility link is INVALID; an unreconciled residual cannot be netted away.

fill_event_link_allocation_control.nonlinkable_event_rule: Each listed event has zero execution_fill_ledger_event_link rows and fill_event_link_set_sha256 equal to the canonical empty set hash; an allocation link on a nonlinkable event is INVALID.

fill_leg_partial_fill_settlement_and_fee.aggregation_rule: Fill sequences are immutable, start at one and are contiguous. The order filled quantity equals the sum of fill quantities, each cumulative_filled_quantity equals the prior cumulative plus the current fill, remaining_submitted_quantity equals submitted less cumulative, and order-level price, fee/tax components and settlement totals equal the exact sum of its fills in stated unit and currency. Every fill_id must reference or sequence-bind the matching execution_order_state_transition; fill timestamp, cumulative and remaining quantities reconcile to that transition, and cancellation/expiry cannot precede a later fill. Allocations may not use a later aggregate fee or settlement amount to overwrite a fill.
fill_leg_partial_fill_settlement_and_fee.partial_fill_rule: A PARTIAL execution has positive cumulative filled quantity below submitted quantity and retains its residual through explicit open, PARTIAL_EXPIRED, PARTIAL_CANCELLED or frozen end-of-run disposition; PARTIAL->FAILED is forbidden. Filled legs retain their own settlement and component-fee allocations even when the residual is cancelled or expires; a partial order cannot be relabeled NO_FILL or settled as its submitted quantity.
fill_leg_partial_fill_settlement_and_fee.failure_rule: A missing leg, noncontiguous sequence, invalid delta/cumulative/residual arithmetic, unallocated leg settlement/fee, or mismatch between leg and order aggregation is INVALID.

paired_transfer_settlement_and_futures_m.event_routing_contract: CASH_ACCRUAL, TRADE_SETTLEMENT, FEES_TAX and MARGIN_TRANSFER_CASH_LEG post only to CASH; DEBIT is permitted only for DEBIT_ACCRUAL and is a nonnegative liability increase. COLLATERAL_TRANSFER posts only to COLLATERAL; INITIAL_MARGIN and MAINTENANCE_MARGIN post to MARGIN. Every event has exactly one daily balance bucket and signed posted_balance_effect_ledger_currency_amount. The daily NAV bridge formula is daily_nav_bridge_from_balances_translated_marks_and_signed_unsettled_residuals.

paired_transfer_conservation_contract.conservation_rule: Each transfer pair has exactly one negative CASH_LEG and exactly one positive MARGIN_LEG or COLLATERAL_LEG in the same replay run, daily ledger, ledger currency and effective time. cash_leg_ledger_currency_amount plus reserve_leg_ledger_currency_amount equals zero; net_nav_effect equals zero; transfer_pair_status is PAIRED; and both legs enter their distinct daily-balance formulas exactly once. An INITIAL_MARGIN, MAINTENANCE_MARGIN or COLLATERAL_TRANSFER event without exactly one such immutable pair is INVALID.
paired_transfer_conservation_contract.dated_collateral_source_rule: For COLLATERAL_TRANSFER, the resolved cash_collateral_terms row has term_type COLLATERAL_TRANSFER, a positive rate_or_timing_value in the declared currency unit, dated effective/source_revision/source_reference evidence, and event effective_at equal to the frozen transfer term. The exact negative cash leg is then required in the same pair; neither an inferred reserve nor an unpriced balance transfer is admissible.

paired_transfer_settlement_and_futures_m.unsettled_settlement_payable_receivable_: For a settlement event, settlement_obligation_status is NOT_APPLICABLE, UNSETTLED, PARTIALLY_SETTLED, SETTLED or FAILED. Gross, posted-or-paid and outstanding ledger-currency amounts reconcile as gross minus posted equals outstanding; outstanding direction is PAYABLE or RECEIVABLE when unsettled/partially settled and NONE when not applicable/settled. unsettled_obligation_ledger_currency_amount is the payable component, unsettled_receivable_ledger_currency_amount the receivable component, and unsettled_net_nav_ledger_currency_amount equals receivable minus payable, so the daily NAV bridge records each residual exactly once. FAILED requires zero posted/paid balance effect, outstanding equal to gross, a PAYABLE/RECEIVABLE direction, a final settlement transition FAILED and source/exception evidence; it cannot be represented as settled, delivery/position-close effect or a passing endpoint.
paired_transfer_settlement_and_futures_m.futures_daily_mtm_contract: For instrument_category FUTURES, valuation_formula_type is FUTURES_DAILY_MARGINED: marked_value and marked_value_ledger_currency are zero, unrealized_pnl is zero, and futures_daily_margin_notional_reference is exposure-only and never enters NAV or TWRR. Variation/final settlement uses prior/current settlement price, calculation_quantity_or_contracts and dated contract multiplier, with the P&L/cashflow linked once to the event. A FUTURES TRADE_SETTLEMENT principal amount is zero unless it is a separately typed futures_non_notional_adjustment_amount with a source reference; it never substitutes fill gross_notional for cash or NAV.
paired_transfer_settlement_and_futures_m.endpoint_invalidation_contract: The frozen endpoint status rule includes no-failed-settlement-in-endpoint-state and failed-settlement-contract-pass predicates. A FAILED settlement or a failed paired-transfer/unsettled-settlement assertion over an endpoint's state makes endpoint_status INVALID, blocks PASS and is retained in population counts.
paired_transfer_settlement_and_futures_m.failure_rule: A wrong bucket, hidden debit funding, unpaired transfer, nonzero transfer net NAV, missing dated collateral term, double-posted or unsigned settlement residual, FAILED settlement treated as completed, futures notional in NAV, or endpoint PASS with a failed settlement is INVALID.

broker_tax_component_fk_and_event_role_m.component_foreign_key_rule: Each fee/tax component is an execution_fee_tax_component directly allocated to one fill_id (or an explicit order-level exception path), uses exactly one component_type from COMMISSION, EXCHANGE_FEE, CLEARING_FEE, OTHER_FEE, TAX or LEVY, and references the effective dated broker_fee_term or tax_levy_term by ID/source revision. Terms must deterministically match dated route, account, instrument-or-product scope, currency and, for TAX/LEVY, jurisdiction. term_calculated_amount in term_output_currency converts to amount/currency only through the frozen_fx_quote_conversion identified by fx_quote_id/fx_quote_sha256, fx_conversion_rate and declared rounding; amount must equal the rounded multiplication, while an identity-currency case remains explicitly evidenced rather than implied. Combined, inferred-zero, null-currency, generic-term-without-effective-scope or unresolved-jurisdiction components are prohibited.
broker_tax_component_fk_and_event_role_m.mapping_rule: Every cashflow/P&L and cash/margin/settlement event carries exactly one event_type and its mapped application_role above. The recorded role, resolved term family and event amount/currency must agree with that mapping. FEES_TAX is mapped to NOT_APPLICABLE_FEE_TAX while its separate CASH_BALANCE role applicability is independently audited; its components use broker/tax terms and are not priced by a cash-yield, debit, collateral or margin term.
broker_tax_component_fk_and_event_role_m.failure_rule: A missing or non-effective component foreign key, ambiguous component type, absent currency/jurisdiction, wrong route/account/scope match, or event-role mapping mismatch is INVALID and blocks usable-strategy status.

execution_settlement_state_and_end_of_ru.separation_rule: execution_state records whether and how an order was attempted or filled; settlement_state records the subsequent clearing, delivery or cash status. SUBMITTED and FAILED are valid execution states. A filled order with a settlement problem remains execution_state FILLED and settlement_state FAILED; no unqualified FAILED state may merge the two domains. Direct NOT_APPLICABLE->SETTLED is permitted only for DOCUMENTED_INSTANTANEOUS_CLEARING at a positive fill time with linked settlement event and source evidence; otherwise a positive fill starts PENDING.
execution_settlement_state_and_end_of_ru.end_of_run_rule: At replay end every order has one end_of_run_order_disposition. Terminal orders use NO_OPEN_ORDER. Any nonterminal CREATED, SUBMITTED or PARTIAL order is CANCELLED_AT_RUN_END or EXPIRED_AT_RUN_END unless CARRIED_WITH_OPENING_STATE is explicitly permitted by the frozen policy and links a hash-bound next-run opening-state manifest. Carry does not imply a fill or settlement and cannot cross into PRIMARY_HOLDOUT; cancellation/expiry does not erase filled-leg obligations. A formal endpoint must disclose all dispositions and cannot silently mark an open row closed.
execution_settlement_state_and_end_of_ru.failure_rule: A row with only one overloaded state, a missing SUBMITTED/FAILED execution treatment, an unclassified settlement state, or an unrecorded end-of-run carry/cancel disposition is INVALID.

state_components: cash, debit, accrued income, fees and tax
pending or unsettled cashflows and obligations
open orders, partial fills and order-state transitions
roll, delivery, expiry and forced-reduction state
any parameter, eligibility or signal state that affects a decision
primary_holdout_start_state_control.per_primary_window_requirement: Every PRIMARY_HOLDOUT candidate endpoint requires one hash-bound start-state manifest and normalized primary_holdout_start_state_component membership rows. Each component row carries the frozen run binding, manifest foreign key, component type, source interval, ledger/lot/cashflow/reconciliation foreign key or explicit neutral-reset evidence and integrity status. At window_start, every component must either be a deterministic neutral reset at or after lockbox_holdout_start or be reconstructed solely from post-lockbox source records and rule-generated actions during the declared warmup. Carrying development-period state is prohibited.
primary_holdout_start_state_control.failure_rule: A missing manifest, a component with pre-lockbox provenance, an unexplained state carry, a mismatch between component hashes and the daily/order ledger, or a failed integrity status makes the candidate CROSSING or INVALID under the frozen protocol; it cannot be PRIMARY_HOLDOUT.

cash_collateral_role_applicability_contr.required_audit: For every order or dated ledger event, a role-applicability audit must evaluate CASH_BALANCE, DEBIT_BALANCE, COLLATERAL, TRADE_SETTLEMENT, INITIAL_MARGIN, MAINTENANCE_MARGIN, VARIATION_MARGIN and FINAL_SETTLEMENT against frozen route, account, contract, currency and ledger-state triggers.
cash_collateral_role_applicability_contr.minimum_trigger_rules: A submitted order requires CASH_BALANCE and requires TRADE_SETTLEMENT when the route or contract transfers transaction cash. A filled derivative requires each applicable INITIAL_MARGIN, MAINTENANCE_MARGIN and VARIATION_MARGIN role. DEBIT_BALANCE, COLLATERAL and FINAL_SETTLEMENT are required exactly when their dated ledger/contract trigger is present.
cash_collateral_role_applicability_contr.not_applicable_boundary: A role may be NOT_APPLICABLE only with a source-proven route, contract or rule reason tied to the effective timestamp. Null, an empty role list or an undefined funding_or_margin_terms_apply flag cannot imply not applicable.
cash_collateral_role_applicability_contr.failure_rule: A missing audit row, unsupported not-applicable conclusion, unresolved role, wrong term-set member or route/account/scope/currency mismatch is material and blocks usable-strategy status.

cash_collateral_scope_resolution_control.resolution_rule: At an effective timestamp, select the one highest-priority term matching route, account, currency, term type and scope. ACCOUNT_WIDE has a null scope value. Two effective terms at the same priority, a lower-priority override, a scope-type/value mismatch or no match is INVALID.
cash_collateral_scope_resolution_control.failure_rule: No role, cash accrual, margin or settlement amount may be reconciled until scope resolution has one deterministic effective term.

order_transition_and_event_reconciliatio.transition_chain_rule: For each order, transitions are contiguous from sequence 1, begin at CREATED, link adjacent to_state/from_state, use only frozen allowed edges and reconcile their timestamps, quantities and terminal execution/settlement states exactly to the order ledger.
order_transition_and_event_reconciliatio.typed_event_rule: Every cash, debit, collateral, trade-settlement, initial/maintenance/variation-margin or final-settlement event maps to a dated daily portfolio ledger row and, when order-linked, to its order. It records route, account, currency, instrument/category context, resolved term, source revision and amount. Aggregate ledger currency and any conversion source/time are explicit.
order_transition_and_event_reconciliatio.failure_rule: A side chain, sequence gap, orphan event, missing aggregate-link, unreferenced conversion, state/quantity/timestamp mismatch or unsupported scope resolution is INVALID.

execution_model_partial_fill_fee_tax_and.execution_legality_rule: Every order binds an execution-model ID/basis, an ETF or futures tradability-session composite key and a legal-session/price-limit outcome. For instrument_category ETF, execution_order_ledger.intended_execution_side/execution_side and execution_fill_ledger.execution_side must never be OPEN_SHORT or CLOSE_SHORT, and portfolio_position_lot_mark_ledger.position_side must never be SHORT; no borrow model is assumed. Quote, proxy and no-fill evidence are mutually exclusive as specified by that basis. The frozen model also binds liquidity capacity basis, quote/depth source, consumed and remaining capacity, impact-model or conservative-proxy foreign key and hash; each fill quantity must not exceed remaining displayed/model capacity, and FILL_TIME_QUOTE cannot bypass capacity. A submitted fill cannot bypass halted, limit-locked, delivery-restricted or no-quote status.
execution_model_partial_fill_fee_tax_and.partial_fill_rule: A partial fill has positive filled quantity below submitted quantity and remains open only with a later retained transition. Its terminal residual is explicitly PARTIAL_EXPIRED or PARTIAL_CANCELLED, with residual amount, timestamp, reason and filled-portion settlement events. A zero-fill NO_FILL/EXPIRED state is not a substitute for a partial-fill terminal state.
execution_model_partial_fill_fee_tax_and.fee_tax_rule: Commission and tax/levy components carry dated source references, amounts and currencies. Their ledger events use broker/tax pricing rather than cash-yield/margin terms, reconcile exactly to the order and daily cash ledger, and never double count an investor cost or assume a currency.
execution_model_partial_fill_fee_tax_and.endpoint_rule: Every endpoint is a normalized keyed result row with window, partition, status and input hash. Each PRIMARY_HOLDOUT endpoint explicitly links its predicate audit and post-lockbox start-state manifest/hash; no Boolean hurdle may be computed from an unkeyed narrative table.
execution_model_partial_fill_fee_tax_and.failure_rule: A missing execution/tradability link, ambiguous quote/proxy path, illegal fill, partial-fill misclassification, untraced fee/tax/currency, quantity violation, or unkeyed endpoint mapping is INVALID.

revision_history.reason: Add primary-holdout count controls plus immutable cash-collateral term-set and order-state-transition requirements before any outcome is viewed.
Bind robust interpretation, primary-holdout predicate/invalidation, explicit state-transition matrix and conjunctive usable-strategy/risk-feasibility controls before any outcome is viewed.
Make the canonical replay-freeze crosswalk complete and require prospective state/configuration coverage before any usable-strategy label.
Adopt the v3 order-to-term schema and clarify strict primary-holdout plus effective route/account/scope/currency paper-state controls before any outcome is viewed.
Require post-lockbox primary-holdout start-state provenance and conditional pre-submit rejection/not-submitted timestamp controls before any outcome is viewed.
Make cash, margin, collateral and settlement role applicability deterministic rather than nullable before any outcome is viewed.
Make order-transition chains, cash/margin/settlement event linkage, currency conversion and term-scope precedence machine-checkable before any outcome is viewed.
Close execution-model/tradability, partial-fill, fee/tax-currency and keyed endpoint-result controls before any outcome is viewed.

universe_coverage_control.u0_to_t2_derivation_requirement: A future T2 freeze must bind a U0 snapshot hash and a derivation audit that reports per-class population/qualified counts, every T2 parent_class_id, inclusion/exclusion reason, rule ID and approved exception.

universe_coverage_control.restricted_scope_rule: If a run excludes an in-scope U0 class because its module or evidence is incomplete, the run is coverage-restricted and must disclose omitted classes. It cannot be named an open domestic multi-asset test.
universe_coverage_control.manual_nomination_prohibition: No product, issuer, contract or option series can enter T2 through manual nomination without the frozen U0 derivation audit.

global_provenance_controls.run_scoped_output_lineage_rule: Every derived run-scoped table, audit and report listed in frozen_run_binding_and_bound_row_control is emitted only after the canonical replay_run_freeze_record exists and carries the identical binding tuple. File paths, case ID or a later report-level hash cannot substitute for row-level lineage.
revision_policy: Raw files are append-only. Later corrections create a new raw object and point to the superseded hash.
A normalized record carries the exact raw hash and source revision used.
A replay chooses a declared revision cut-off and reports every subsequent restatement separately.

calendar_and_time.late_or_missing_arrival: Record the failed or late retrieval attempt, retry policy and final status. Do not silently substitute a later observation.

cross_source_reconciliation.unresolved_conflict: Exclude the affected record from the formal replay or classify it as failed data quality; never choose the favorable value ad hoc.

packages.scope: Every ETF in the frozen decision universe. The current comparison codes 511010.SH, 510300.SH, 510880.SH, 518880.SH and 511990.SH remain illustrative only and are not admitted by this contract.

documented_endpoint_family.boundary: The local evidence documents field families only. It does not evidence entitlement, an archive, retention permission, revision history or point-in-time vintage.

record_schema.unit_currency_precision_policy: Declare unit, currency, decimal precision and rounding policy per source field in the frozen data dictionary. The default local currency label is CNY only when the raw source says so.
record_schema.available_at_definition: Store vendor publication time if available, local response receipt time, and the documented earliest usable availability. The formal decision engine may use only the latter.

collection_and_quality.cadence: Historical import and forward collection cadence must be declared in the freeze record. Each expected session must have a success, no-data, delayed, holiday or failed-attempt record.
collection_and_quality.coverage_test: For every active frozen-universe instrument and expected session, require one canonical market row or a documented exchange/source exception. Duplicate primary keys fail.
collection_and_quality.event_reconciliation: Reconcile adjusted/accumulated NAV to an independent distribution/action ledger. Every cash event is booked exactly once; adjusted series cannot be combined with separate cash without an explicit reconciliation.
collection_and_quality.conflict_test: Price, NAV, event and status conflicts follow the global reconciliation protocol.
collection_and_quality.failure_handling: A missing price, action timestamp, tradability state or provenance tuple makes the affected decision/replay observation ineligible under the frozen no-fill/exclusion rule.

packages.scope: Every actual listed AU, CU and TA contract in the frozen universe on each decision session. No continuous, retrospectively labeled main-contract or vendor-synthesized series may substitute for contract selection, roll or P&L.

documented_endpoint_family.boundary: Retained exchange samples demonstrate a current source path but were retrieved retrospectively. They do not establish full historical point-in-time availability, entitlement, a lifecycle master or rulebook coverage.

collection_and_quality.roll_test: Contract choice and roll must use the same-day full cross-section and lifecycle state, then execute no earlier than the next eligible session.
collection_and_quality.marking_test: Variation P&L is marked at actual daily settlement. Close remains a separate field and cannot silently replace settlement.
collection_and_quality.failure_handling: Delivery-buffer breach, limit lock, suspension, unavailable successor, missing liquidity, missing term or missing provenance produces the predeclared no-fill/hold/exclusion state.

packages.scope: Dated broker-route, exchange/session, tax and liquidity evidence for each instrument considered in a paper replay or prospective reconciliation.

collection_and_quality.embedded_fee_control: Fund expenses embedded in NAV are recorded as such and cannot be charged again as investor transaction cost.
collection_and_quality.fill_control: Every assumed transaction requires a legal session, documented typed tradability state, frozen execution-model/quote-or-proxy basis, frozen quote/depth/capacity/impact or proxy evidence, intended execution side, submission path, route, immutable cash-collateral term-set ID, deterministic cash/collateral role-applicability and scope-resolution audit, quote/submit/reject/fill/expiry causal trail, typed cash/margin/settlement event linkage and separate contiguous execution and settlement transition chains. SUBMITTED and FAILED are valid execution states; settlement uses NOT_APPLICABLE, PENDING, PARTIALLY_SETTLED, SETTLED or FAILED. Every positive fill has an immutable fill_id/sequence, cumulative_filled_quantity, remaining_submitted_quantity, direct fee/tax component and settlement allocations, and a matching execution-state transition; fill quantity cannot exceed remaining capacity. Quantities must satisfy target/submitted/filled bounds. A partial fill must remain open or reach an explicit partial-expired/cancelled/failed residual state; it cannot be recast as zero-fill. At end-of-run every order has NO_OPEN_ORDER, CANCELLED_AT_RUN_END, EXPIRED_AT_RUN_END or permitted CARRIED_WITH_OPENING_STATE treatment. A pre-submit rejection or not-submitted decision must retain its decision-to-rejection/not-submitted stage, code and reference without inventing a submission timestamp. A close is not an assumed fill unless the rule explicitly supports it with evidence.
collection_and_quality.cost_change_control: A cost or tax change is effective only from its documented effective date.

prospective_reconciliation.minimum_observation_rule: Before any usable-strategy upgrade, both thresholds are required: at least 60 calendar days must elapse from the first eligible decision AND at least 10 distinct eligible decision, roll, settlement or no-fill observations must be retained, with at least one observation for every admitted U0 parent class.

applicable_cases: created/submitted/partial/filled/no-fill/expired/rejected/not-submitted/failed execution states and separate pending/partially-settled/settled/settlement-failed/end-run-carried/end-run-cancelled settlement or disposition paths, including pre-submit rejection and not-submitted paths
cash/collateral term-set, role-applicability, scope-resolution, broker-route and currency-conversion changes or exceptions
cash/debit/collateral/margin/settlement events and their exact event_type-to-application_role mapping and order-to-daily-ledger reconciliation

state_configuration_coverage_matrix.coverage_rule: Exactly one configuration_tuple_sha256 row is required for every frozen applicable parent class, broker route/terms revision, cash-collateral term set/term/scope/role, material transaction/event, execution-model/tradability, execution/settlement/residual/end-of-run path. A row is admissible only when coverage_disposition is OBSERVED, ACCEPTED_CONSERVATIVE or SOURCE_PROVEN_NOT_APPLICABLE, it has evidence_reference and review_status PASS. UNRESOLVED, FAILED, a missing expected tuple or non-PASS review is blocking; rare events must not be manufactured.
state_configuration_coverage_matrix.uniqueness_rule: coverage_row_id is unique within replay_run_id and configuration_tuple_sha256 is unique within replay_run_id. A duplicate, missing configuration tuple or differing bound-run hash is INVALID rather than a way to reduce the blocking count.
state_configuration_coverage_matrix.pass_rule: The 60-day and 10-observation minimum is necessary but not sufficient. The zero-blocking assertion is derived only from the hash-bound rows: count(coverage_disposition in UNRESOLVED,FAILED) + count(review_status != PASS) + missing expected configuration tuple count must equal 0. A narrative declaration, omitted tuple or aggregate netting cannot make the audit pass.

prospective_reconciliation.unit_consistency_rule: Every tolerance compares values in the same stated unit and currency. A cross-unit comparison is prohibited unless a separately frozen conversion source, timestamp and rounding rule are bound.

materiality_by_field.order_state_and_quantity: Any status mismatch, unmodeled no-fill/partial fill or quantity mismatch beyond the documented lot size is material.
materiality_by_field.execution_price: An absolute observed-versus-modeled execution-price difference greater than the larger of one documented tick and 25% of the modeled per-unit price-impact component, both expressed in the same quote-price unit, is material. If the modeled per-unit component is unavailable, the comparison is unresolved and material.
materiality_by_field.fees_and_tax: Any observed-versus-modeled fee or tax difference greater than the dated source rounding increment in the same currency is material.
materiality_by_field.margin_collateral_and_funding: Any unmatched route, account, scope, effective term, rate, day-count, compounding, accrual timing, transfer cutoff or margin state is material; same-term monetary reconciliation must be within the documented source rounding increment.
materiality_by_field.quote_and_impact: A quote snapshot mismatch, quote older than the frozen maximum age, missing depth where the model requires depth, or impact-method mismatch is material.
materiality_by_field.route_and_market_status: An unavailable route/term, legal-session mismatch or market-status mismatch is material.

prospective_reconciliation.material_difference_definition: A difference is material if any materiality_by_field condition is met. No aggregate offset may net a material difference away.
prospective_reconciliation.tolerance_and_escalation: Every material difference blocks admission until independently classified, corrected under a new frozen version if needed, and re-observed. No unresolved material difference is permitted.
prospective_reconciliation.override_policy: Overrides require a reason, approver, timestamp, source reference and independent risk review.

acceptance_tests: Each replay transaction and run-scoped ledger/audit row has the canonical replay_run_id/replay_run_freeze_record_sha256 binding and maps to dated broker_fee_term and tax_levy_term foreign keys, typed session-status/tradability, fill-leg cost/allocation, deterministic cash/collateral role-applicability/scope-resolution, exact event-type-to-application-role mapping, typed cash/margin/settlement event, fee/tax currency/jurisdiction and separate execution/settlement transition evidence.
No transaction has an implicit zero commission, zero tax, zero spread or guaranteed fill.

Every positive fill has contiguous immutable fill legs whose quantity, price, component fee/tax and settlement allocations reconcile exactly to the order; every open execution/pending settlement has an explicit end-of-run carry/cancel disposition.
Each transaction-time sale and derivative exposure has a reconciled lot/T+1 eligibility and cash/collateral/margin reservation record; unitization does not bypass integer-lot or funding feasibility.
Fund-level expense and investor-level transaction cost are not double counted.

Prospective paper-reconciliation log meets both duration and observation-count thresholds, compares all mandatory fields using same-unit tolerances, completes the hash-bound applicable state/configuration coverage audit and has zero unvalidated blocking rows, zero missing required rows and no unresolved material difference before any strategy upgrade.
